summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MarketDesk Focused U.S. Momentum ETF (FMTM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in large- and mid-cap US stocks exhibiting positive momentum. FMTM was launched on Mar 20, 2025 and is issued by MarketDesk.

holdings.infoBox: FMTM is an equity ETF with a total of 32 individual holdings. The top holdings are Illumina stock at 4.32%, Natera at 4.30%, RingCentral at 3.86%, Guardant Health at 3.70%, and Thermo Fisher Scientific at 3.67%.
